title: The Helix Nebula
caption: The Helix Nebula, imaged by the MPG/ESO 2.2-meter telescope at La Silla
celestial: Helix Nebula, NGC 7293 · constellation Aquarius · about 700 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Ranked #8 on ESO’s published “Top 100 Images” list (an institutional selection, not an audience score).

story: A blue-green glow fills the center of this nebula, while farther out, beyond a ring of small knots, red light takes over. This is the Helix Nebula, also known as NGC 7293, photographed with the Wide Field Imager camera on the 2.2-meter Max-Planck Society/ESO telescope at La Silla in Chile.

The Helix is a planetary nebula, made of the outer layers of a dying star that were cast off into space and are now lit by the hot remnant left behind. In the Helix that remnant is a central star of about 120 000 degrees Celsius. Its intense ultraviolet radiation, together with hot gas, makes oxygen atoms shine blue-green near the middle, while hydrogen and nitrogen give the outer parts their red color.
A close look at the central region picks out the knots and also distant galaxies, visible straight through the thin, glowing gas.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (28.02 x 25.94 arcminutes) and distance (700 light years), the frame spans roughly 5.7 × 5.3 light-years. Its light set out about 700 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This is a visible-light color composite from the Wide Field Imager, built from blue, green and red filter images. The caption ties the blue-green glow to oxygen and the red to hydrogen and nitrogen.
understand.eye: Exposures lasting several minutes gather far more light than the eye can, revealing faint gas and distant galaxies that would be invisible through an eyepiece.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: The picture was assembled from exposures through blue, green and red filters, lasting 12, 9 and 7 minutes respectively.
alt: A nebula with a blue-green center, a ring of small knots, and red outer regions.
